abilities.name: Carnage
abilities.description: Mana: 40 Cooldown: 6 seconds Unleash your sword in the target direction, continuously dealing 30 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in its path.

abilities.name: Blood Rage
abilities.description: Mana: 35 Cooldown: 7 seconds Qhira deals 32 (+4% per level) damage and heals for 90 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero affected. Damage and healing is increased by 50% per each additional stack on that Hero.  Passive: Basic Attack and Ability damage cause enemies to bleed for 28 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. Stacks 5 times.  Quest: Damage enemy Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage to permanently increase its damage by 0.2%.   Reward: After damaging Heroes with Blood Rage's bleed damage 150 times, Blood Rage's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Revolving Sweep
abilities.description: Mana: 70 Cooldown: 16 seconds Attach your sword on the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 96 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.25 seconds. Once attached, Qhira becomes Immune to all effects, swinging around the target for 2.75 seconds and dealing 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies between you and the target.  Re-activate to send you to the target's location knocking them away, dealing 108 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Strikes
abilities.description: Mana: 50 Cooldown: 60 seconds Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Final Strike
abilities.description: Mana: 45 Cooldown: 40 seconds After 1 second, deal 410 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

abilities.name: Grappling Hook
abilities.description: Cooldown: 20 seconds Qhira fires a grappling hook that pulls her to terrain it contacts. If an enemy Hero is hit, they take 35 (+4% per level) damage and Qhira launches at them, kicking them for an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage.  Can be used while Revolving Sweep is active.

abilities.name: Summon Mount
abilities.description: Cooldown: 4 seconds After Channeling for 1 second, gain 30% Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Hearthstone
abilities.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health and 150 Mana.

abilities.name: Revolving Sweep
abilities.description: Fly into your target dealing 108 (+4% per level) damage, knocking them away and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

talents.name: Maximum Effort
talents.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Fatal Wounds
talents.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 70% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.

talents.name: Finishing Touch
talents.description: Gain 20% Basic Attack damage. When Qhira Basic Attacks an enemy Hero below 50% Health it deals 20% additional damage, and she gains 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Upstage
talents.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

talents.name: Ensnaring Swing
talents.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

talents.name: Your Pain, My Gain
talents.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero causes Qhira to gain 10 Armor for 3 seconds. Stacks 3 times.

talents.name: The Thirst
talents.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

talents.name: Healmonger
talents.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 210 (+4% per level) Health.

talents.name: Siphoning Link
talents.description: Damaging an enemy Hero with Revolving Sweep's initial impact or swing causes Qhira to regenerate 96 (+4% per level) Health over 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.  Passive: Basic Attacks heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

talents.name: Unrelenting Strikes
talents.description: Mana: 50 Cooldown: 60 seconds Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Final Strike
talents.description: Mana: 45 Cooldown: 40 seconds After 1 second, deal 410 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. This damage is increased by 25% against enemy Heroes who are below 50% Health.

talents.name: Chainsaw
talents.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

talents.name: Pulsing Pain
talents.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage.

talents.name: The Hunted
talents.description: Basic Attacking an enemy Hero increases your Basic Attack damage against that Hero by 25%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 4 seconds. Bonus is reset if a different Hero is attacked.

talents.name: Booming Kick
talents.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

talents.name: Lingering Ailment
talents.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 25 for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Swing Life Away
talents.description: Revolving Sweep's cooldown recharges 250% faster while Qhira is swinging around her target. She also gains 60 Spell Armor for 5 seconds after the re-activation impact.

talents.name: Silent Killer
talents.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

talents.name: Unleashed Potential
talents.description: Increase the damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health from 25% to 50%.  If an enemy Hero dies within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Final Strike, then reset the cooldowns of Final Strike and all of Qhira's Basic Abilities.

talents.name: Utility Belt
talents.description: Grappling Hook's cooldown is reset when hitting an enemy Hero with the initial impact of Revolving Sweep and recharges 900% faster if Qhira hasn't taken damage within the last 2 seconds.

talents.name: No Sanctuary
talents.description: Nearby enemy Heroes below 50% Health are revealed and you gain 20% Movement Speed while an enemy Hero is revealed by you in this way.  Additionally, you deal 20% increased damage to these revealed enemies.
